name: Ravemon: Burst Mode
xros_req:
[Burst Digivolve] [Ravemon]: By returning 1 [Keenan Crier] to hand, cost 0
At the end of the burst digivolution turn, trash this Digimon's top card.
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] Search your opponent's hand, choose 1 card, and trash it. Then, if your opponent has 7 or less cards in their hand, your opponent adds the top card of their security stack to their hand.
[When Attacking] By returning 1 Digimon card from your opponent's trash to the bottom of their deck, delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the same name as that card.
